selected_evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage on node1
selected_evidence.summary: Packages fetched locally, indexed with apk index, served via darkhttpd (first as a foreground test process, then as a persistent OpenRC service) with curl confirming APKINDEX.tar.gz is reachable over HTTP from local storage.

DNS sinkhole for dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org caused curl to fail with 'Connection refused', and apk update showed WARNING: Connection refused for both remote main/community repos while the local repo responded.

selected_evidence.requirement: Install a package from the local repository while remote is unreachable
selected_evidence.summary: apk add --allow-untrusted tree succeeded (exit=0) sourcing only from the local repo (remote still showing connection-refused in the same apk update output); apk info -e tree and `tree --version` confirm real, functional installation.
Captured pre-restart boot_id (82a04a58-92bb-4007-ba72-ce108f861a2f), darkhttpd service status 'started', and confirmed tree installed/functional immediately before initiating restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returns before disconnection
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded `sleep 2; reboot` returned an immediate acknowledgement (PID) to the exec call before the node disconnected.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity after restart
selected_evidence.summary: Node became unreachable (connection reset/timeout) during reboot, then exec succeeded again with a new boot_id (a0d41fb7-ae61-457b-822d-2a614884a8ba) and reset boot time (2026-09-04 23:03:51), proving an actual restart occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required services and data
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, darkhttpd service auto-started and is listening on 8080, the local repo index is fetchable again, tree remains installed and functional, and apk update again shows the local repo active — confirming full recovery.
